lines: In eighty-one-place cakra rising breath-movement-going; in cakra but in ninety-six-named with-quarter two-hundreds would be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ekāśītipade cakre udayaḥ prāṇacāragaḥ cakre tu ṣaṇṇavatyākhye sapādā dviśatī bhavet
